title: RecipeManifest
description: Canonical recipe identity committed as deterministic-manifest.json; its SHA-256 is recorded as index.json.recipe_hash. Covers toolchain, target triple, profile, feature selection, locked dependency graph, command recipe, source-input digests, and resolution policy, with git identity retained as source metadata.

rust_toolchain_toml.description: Raw contents of rust-toolchain.toml if present

rustflags.description: Value of RUSTFLAGS env var if set

features.description: Cargo feature selection; empty until the tool gains feature selection

locked_graph_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical resolved-dependency projection from cargo_metadata.json; null when the bundle carries no such artifact

command_recipe_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical commands.json content

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical inputs_hashes.json content

resolution_policy.description: Dependency-resolution policy the bundle was generated under

git_sha.description: Source commit SHA (metadata, not recipe content)

git_branch.description: Source branch name (metadata, not recipe content)

git_dirty.description: Whether working tree is dirty at capture time (metadata, not recipe content)
